events.title: Employee is fatally injured, canopy being demolished falls
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Courtcon, Inc. Bar Harbor, ME. At 6:45 a.m. on February 24, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a construction laborer and was tearing down a hotel entrance canopy. The canopy also served as a carport for arriving guests. Employee #1 was under the canopy when it suddenlycollapsed. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

events.title: Employee is struck by overhead garage door panel, later dies…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ames Mobile Home Sales, Inc. Canaan, ME. At 12:00 p.m. on November 22, 2024, an employee was in the process of removing apanel from an old overhead garage door. After the panel was disconnected, it slipped and struck the employee, causing him to fall to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained head injuries, which ultimately led to his death 20 days later.

The impact caused him to fall and become caught at the waist. Emergency services responded to the scene. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

Emergency services were contacted, and the employee was attended to on-site. Further details regarding the nature of the medical event and its cause are unknown at this time. The employee died, and this was a not work-related medical event.

events.title: Employee is killed in explosion during welding on diesel tan…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Glover Company, Inc. Rockport, ME. At 2:45 p.m. on May 31, 2024, Employee #1 was performing welding work on a diesel fuel tank. During the welding process, an explosion occurred, resulting in the employee's fatal injuries. The explosion was caused by overpressure inside the tank, which caused metal parts to be ejected. Emergency services responded to the scene, but the employee was pronounced dead from injuries sustained in the explosion.

events.title: Employee is killed after fall while performing tree trimming…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Tip Top Tree Services, Llc. China, ME. At 12:45 p.m. on July 5, 2023, an employee was cutting parts of a tree as part of a tree removal process. It is believed that the employee cut the lanyard hooked to the safety line. The employee fell 40 feet and snapped his spine. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies after fracturing pelvis and femur in fall
events.description: 1 worker death. Lebanon, ME. At 1:00 p.m. on June 15, 2023, an employee was performing traffic control adjacent to an excavator being operated by a private contractor. The employee's heel became caught under the track of the excavator, and he fell to the ground on his back, fracturing his pelvis and femur. The employee was hospitalized anddied approximately 9 days later from complication of his injuries.

events.title: Employee dies, found unresponsive due to natural causes
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Auburn School Department. Auburn, ME. At 9:00 a.m. on February 18, 2023, an employee working for a city school transportation department was fueling a bus with propane. The employee was found by a coworker partially on the bus unresponsive. The employee had no signs of trauma except for a laceration on his head from falling. The employee died at the scene. The medical examiner ruled the cause of death as atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and the manner of death as natural.

events.title: Employee is killed by electrocution
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pacific Construction Services, Inc. Friendship, ME. At 1:59 p.m. on February 7, 2023, an employee was installing metal roofing. The employee was moving with a piece of metal roofing and hit a high voltage powerline. The employee was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee dies after sustaining multiple injuries in fall fro…
events.description: 1 worker death. Raymond, ME. At 9:15 a.m. on January 4, 2023, an employee was removing bags full of bottles and cans from a yard trailer and placing them on the concrete floor inside a garage. The employee stepped back, misjudging the proximity of the trailer, and fell to the floor below. The employee sustained four fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and a brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized and later died as a result of his injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed, breaks neck when garage structural suppo…
events.description: 1 worker death. Rockland, ME. At 10:30 a.m. on June 4, 2022, an employee was removing structural supports from a garage. The building collapsed and fell on him. The employee broke his neck and was killed when the entire roof of the garage being demolished unexpectedly collapsed. A coworker was also injured. An engineering survey was not performed by a competent person prior to allowing garage demolition operations to begin. The walls and attic floor of the garage were not braced and the employee and coworkers were allowed…

events.title: Employee dies after collapsing at store
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dg Retail, Llc. Glenburn, ME. At 8:30 p.m. on May 9, 2022, an employee was stocking shelves in a retail store.The employee collapsed and died from an unspecified body system illness and/or injury.

events.title: Employee falls from scaffold, receives head injury and later…
events.description: 1 worker death. Ogunquit, ME. At 1:00 a.m. on February 1, 2022, an employee worked from a scaffold and at somepoint, fell approximately thirty feet. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to treat a serious head injury, but later died of the injury.

events.title: Employee is killed by suspected heart attack
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Deblois Electric, Inc. Lewiston, ME. At 12:00 p.m. on January 18, 2022, an employee was doing office work and mentioned to a coworker that he was not feeling well. The coworker left for lunch and when he returned, found the employee slumped in their chair and unresponsive. The coworker called for emergency response and another coworker performed CPR until they arrived. Emergency responders declared the employee dead upon arrival to the workplace due to suspected heart attack.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Worcester Resources, Inc. Columbia Falls, ME. An employee was working in a manufacturing facility when she left work feeling ill on November 10, 2021. The employee was transported to the hospital on November 13, 2021, where she died on November 15, 2021, due to COVID-19-related complications.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Windham, ME. An employee was working for a firearms manufacturer when he contracted COVID-19.The employee's symptoms worsened and he subsequently died on November 5, 2021, due to COVID-19 complications.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Hodgdon, ME. An employee was working as a protective services administrator for a government agency that was charged with border protection. He worked in an office. He was exposed to COVID-19 while at work, and he contracted the disease. At 2:30 p.m. on October 8, 2021, he died.

events.title: Employee dies from unknown natural causes

He went to the bed area of the semi truck and went to sleep. He died from unknown natural causes.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed when excavator falls into exc…

At some point, the soil under the excavator collapsed and the excavator fell into the excavation onto the employee. The employee received crushing injuries to the abdomen and pelvis and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in trip and fall incident

The employee suffered a broken pelvis and eventually died from her injury.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling branch

events.title: Employee is killed when garbage truck rolls over

The employee was killed instantly.

The employee got out the truck but the truck continued to move. As the truck was moving, the employee began running alongside the truck in an attempt to try reach inside again but fell to the ground. The employee was crushed when the truck rolled over him and was stopped when it struck a parked vehicle. The…

events.title: Employee is run over by garbage truck and is killed

events.title: Employees are caught in propane explosion, one is killed and…
events.description: 1 worker death. Farmington, ME. At 8:28 a.m. on September 16, 2019, seven employees had responded to a 911 call for the smell of propane in a newly renovated building and were caught in an explosion after deploying in and around the building. Employee #1 was killed in the explosion and the other six employees suffered multiple injuries comprised of fractures, burns, concussions, and lacerations.

events.title: Employee is run over by garbage truck and is killed

events.title: Employee is struck by fallen tree and fractures skull

events.title: Employee arriving at work dies from heart attack

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Portland, ME. At 11:53 a.m. on December 13, 2018, an employee was climbing down off of a roof onto a ladder jack scaffolding plank. The employee lost his footing and fell 20feet to the ground. The employee was not wearing any fall protection. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed when barn collapses
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Suydam & Sons General Contractors. Knox, ME. At 9:45 a.m. on September 13, 2018, an employee was assisting in the dismantling of a barn. As the employee was using a chainsaw to cut the overhead section of the barn floor, a forklift was lifting a precut section. During work, the overhead floor collapsed and trapped the employee and coworkers beneath the debris. The employee suffered a broken neck and was killed. However, the other coworkers survived with only one sustaining a laceration to the back of his head.

events.title: Employee dies after collapsing at a meeting

events.title: Employee is crushed beneath carrier beam and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Irving Forest Products, Inc. Dixfield, ME. At 8:55 a.m. on March 3, 2018, an employee was adjusting a jack stand that was supporting a grapple hook carrier beam. The jack stand gave way, allowing the carrier beam to tip over. The employee became pinned beneath the carrier beam, suffering multiple injuries that resulted in his death.

events.title: Employee collapses , falls from roof, and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Old Town, ME. At 3:45 p.m. on October 27, 2017, an employee was working on a roof and collapsed. The employee fell from the roof and suffered a neck injury, killing the employee.

events.title: Employee is killed when he fell and hit his head while skiin…

As the employee transitioned from one snow type to another, he lost his balance and fell. Employee #1 tumbled about 100 yards before coming to rest against a snow ski jump. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to his head and was killed.

events.title: Employee dies from heart attack while loading cardboard bale…
events.description: 1 worker death. Ellsworth, ME. At 10:00 a.m. on December 18, 2016, an employee was pulling a cart and loading cardboard into a baler. The individual cardboard boxes weighed less than five pounds and the cart was in excellent condition. The employee apparently suffered a heart attack. The electrical systems were grounded and bonded and the carbon monoxide levels were normal.

events.title: Employee is killed when caught under tread of bulldozer

He received multiple internal injuries from being crushed under bulldozer tread and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed after jumping from roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Afy Interior System Llc. Biddeford, ME. At 7:31 a.m. on June 7, 2016, and employee jumped head first off of a 5 story roof. While speaking with his mother on his cell phone, the employee climbed the stairs of a building adjacent to the construction site, climbed out of a 4thfloor window, and proceeded to climb a safety ladder to the 5th story roof. The employee jumped from the high elevation and sustained intense head and chest trauma, causing his death.

events.title: Employee falls off deck and is killed

The employee was under a 12 foot subtrunk when his coworker made a cut that freed the subtrunk from the main trunk. The employee was crushed when struck by the subtrunk.
